scope: How a RuLSIF control would enter T03 (synthetic tables with known eta). This is an integration contract, not a run experiment: no T03 RuLSIF unit exists and none is scheduled in this round (no new grid without a frozen pre-registration).

reference.primary: complete empirical U, as for the T03 main target (Q = P_X P_Y built from all within-sample cross pairs)
reference.V: the fixed-critic V reading stays a diagnostic only, as for the other T03 methods

output_scale_and_common_J.estimator: RuLSIF with alpha = 0.5 estimates the relative ratio r = p / (0.5 p + 0.5 q) = p / M
output_scale_and_common_J.mapping: T = g - 1 with g the fitted ratio; at the population optimum g = 2p/(p+q) = 1 + eta, so T = eta, the same target as the VCS critics
output_scale_and_common_J.common_J: J(T) = E_P[T] - E_Q[T] - 0.5 (E_P[T^2] + E_Q[T^2]), read by the unchanged T03 evaluator, so that S - J_pop(T) = E_M[(T - eta)^2] applies without rescaling
output_scale_and_common_J.constraint: E_M[g] = 1 must hold for the fitted g (checked as in tests/v10/test_rulsif_v2.py); the constant basis is not ridge-penalised (lambda D, D = diag(0, 1, ..., 1))

data_and_selection_isolation.fit: FIT samples only (P pairs and the U product reference of the same FIT sample)
data_and_selection_isolation.selection: bandwidth multiplier and ridge selected by maximum CAL U-J, ties to the earlier candidate; eta and S never read
data_and_selection_isolation.evaluation: EVAL U-J, population MSE and EVAL - J_pop computed only by the evaluator-only channel, after the critic is frozen
data_and_selection_isolation.truth: eta / S stay in evaluator_only, exactly as for the existing T03 methods

capacity_disclosure: kernel dictionary size, centre allocation and bandwidth rule must be fixed before any T03 table is read; a natural-image setting (BF/EPFL 1024 centres) is not transferred without a frozen choice
micro_numeric_check_plan: small-n exhaustive enumeration of U pairs on a T03 two_block table: moments, normal-equation solution, J value and the E_M[g] = 1 identity against float64 references (the existing tests/v10/test_rulsif_v2.py checks, run on a T03 table)
not_claimed: the natural-image RuLSIF v2 completion does not make the T03 synthetic baseline set complete
InfoNCE raw outputs are not converted to an RMSE against eta
